name: phone_action
description: Perform one allowlisted action in the a serve Android app. now returns phone-local time/timezone; calendar_read lists events; calendar_add creates a timed event; sms only opens a pre-filled composer and NEVER sends; note remains a share sheet requiring the user to choose an app/save. alarm/timer dispatch to the clock app: success is NOT verification that an alarm/timer was created. An alarm without weekdays (or []) requests one next occurrence, not a date. Call now before date-dependent actions. location requests foreground precise permission but accepts approximate access: use Android's actual latitude/longitude, accuracy (meters), age_ms, provider and precision; absent metadata is unknown. note_create/note_list/note_update store and edit phone-local notes/todos; todos are text/completion state, NEVER scheduled tasks or reminders. file_import opens the system picker for UTF-8 text only (max 1 MiB); its data is {file_id UUID,filename,mime_type,total_chars,text (first <=3000 codepoints),next_offset,has_more}. Continue with file_read using codepoint offsets. file_save saves UTF-8 only after the user confirms a system create-document destination. Results retain full bounded JSON data (512 KiB response limit), not just a preview; paged results may have has_more. New text bodies are never truncated: serialized requests exceeding the native FIFO limit are rejected before dispatch, so Unicode/escaping may reduce the usable character budget. screen_capture requires explicit Android screen-sharing consent and a visible stoppable foreground service. One consent is reusable only within the same live sharing session (up to 30 minutes), never permanent; screen_stop ends it. screen_capture arms a pending request and waits for the user: ask the user to switch to the target app and tap the '立即截屏' action in the a serve notification, and the frame is captured about a second after that tap. Without a tap the armed request expires after about two minutes. The notification then shows the delivered frame so the user can confirm which moment was sent. The result is a server-local JPEG path: use read_file to view it. Only captures when requested, not continuously uploaded; protected screens remain blank. Use only when the user asks to inspect the screen, not to access another app's hidden history. Only available in the Android client.

action.description: Choose one action. file_import, location and now take no additional arguments. note is the legacy share sheet; note_create stores locally. Alarm/timer success means dispatch only.

days.description: calendar_read: how many days ahead to look (default 7).

title.description: calendar_add: event title. note/note_create: optional title (default empty). note_update: optional replacement title, including empty.

begin_local.description: calendar_add: start as local phone time in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Call action 'now' first to learn the phone's date and timezone.

contact.description: sms: contact display name to look up on the phone. Provide this or 'number'.

number.description: sms: phone number to use instead of a contact lookup. Digits and + - ( ) . spaces only.

text.description: Required nonblank body for note/note_create/file_save (<=3000 codepoints), or sms (<=1000). note_update: optional nonblank replacement body <=3000. New stored/file bodies preserve whitespace verbatim; serialized FIFO byte limits also apply.

hour.description: alarm: hour in 24-hour PHONE local time. Call now for phone time. With omitted/empty weekdays, request once at the next occurrence, never a specific date; creation is not verified.

weekdays.description: alarm: optional unique ISO weekdays, Monday=1 through Sunday=7. Omit or [] for one next occurrence; no alarm date is supported.

kind.description: note_create: entry kind (default note). note_list: optional filter; omitted means both kinds. Todos do not schedule notifications, reminders or tasks.

entry_id.description: note_update: required UUID returned by note_create/note_list, in 8-4-4-4-12 form. Supply at least one of title, text, completed.

completed.description: note_update: optional completion state; Android rejects this for non-todo entries. This does not create a schedule.

file_id.description: file_read: required UUID returned by file_import, in 8-4-4-4-12 form (not a filesystem path or URI).

offset.description: Default 0. note_list: entry offset, maximum 100000. file_read: Unicode codepoint offset, maximum 1048576; use returned next_offset, never UTF-8 bytes or UTF-16 units.

limit.description: file_read: maximum Unicode codepoints per page (default 3000).

filename.description: file_save: required suggested basename, not '.' or '..'; no slash, backslash or control characters. System create-document confirmation is required.
